text: Proposed, refining D-0235 after #355's final review: the profiler that sees a C call raise is set in every thread the threading module runs, so a C call's raise in a thread started through _thread directly goes unseen, though a Python call's is still seen there, since sys.monitoring covers every thread. Each declared exception class its tests' modules have loaded is pinned once they have, before any test runs, so no test method can swap what an Exsures names; a test module that swaps one while it loads is tampering with the run in its own process, which is out of scope.
